acceptance.detail: The evidence ends with “ninja: no work to do,” so it does not establish a build from a clean checkout. I did not rerun ./dev build because it writes to build/ in this read-only verification.
C_STANDARD 17, C_EXTENSIONS NO, the required warning flags, and -Werror are configured; the generated compile line uses -std=c17 and includes those flags.

The logs show Debug and Release compilation and reported version output, and no generated tracked changes are present. They do not establish that both builds began from independent clean build directories.

acceptance.evidence: git diff --cached --check; staged path list; CMakeLists.txt; CMakePresets.json; app/main.c
acceptance.detail: Diff check succeeds, all staged paths are allowed by the WO, and the implementation adds no third-party dependency or fetch target. The untracked OWNER-DIRECTIVES.md is pre-existing and excluded.
AGENTS.md references OWNER-DIRECTIVES.md and states the macOS-only and Apple Silicon boundary. The implementation adds no other-OS code.

scope_findings.finding: The intended macOS 13 deployment target is not active in the observed configure: build/mac-debug/CMakeCache.txt has an empty CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET, and the generated compile line has no macOS 13 minimum-version flag. The cache assignment does not replace an already initialized empty cache value. This conflicts with the stated macOS 13+ support boundary.
The captured “ninja: no work to do” output does not evidence the required clean-checkout build.
The logs show builds but do not record clean build-directory setup, so the independent-clean-build claim is not substantiated by the artifact.

risk_flags: No commit is present for the staged changes; head_sha is therefore empty.
AC-1 and AC-4 clean-build conditions were not independently verified in the read-only environment.
The configured minimum macOS version is ineffective in the observed build cache.
summary: Fail: the staged paths are within the allowlist and the C17, warning, platform-boundary, and CLI checks inspected are sound, but the observed build does not target macOS 13 despite the project’s macOS 13+ boundary. AC-1 and AC-4 evidence also does not establish clean builds.
